Drag to explore · pinch to zoom · tap a blue standard for orders

One field, two perspectives. Switch between the angled 2.5D view and an isometric view. Drag to scout, pinch or scroll to zoom, or follow the action.

Tap a blue formation standard for Hold, Advance, or cavalry Charge cycles. Try landscape for the full army view.

Matchlocks can fire through allies. Bullets fly straight, can miss moving enemies and can hit another enemy on their path. Matchlocks fire 20% slower and lose accuracy at long range. Select cavalry and tap an enemy label to name its preferred target. Units can change shape; pikewalls stay put. Matchlocks need a clear shot. Bows fire overhead with scattered impacts. MRK sets their firing pace. Cavalry flanks exposed ranged units or helps infantry threatened by enemy riders, then withdraws and regroups.

Separate prototype. Uses the game’s procedural art and damage formulas with experimental movement and targeting. Campaign, saves and full duel cinematics are not connected. Each figure represents a share of its formation.
